date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: The centre was already reported closed for coronavirus prevention by 27 January 2020; this is a latest-onset bound, not an exact observed start. The report distinguishes an earlier holiday closure from 22 January, whose onset is not imported into this COVID phase. The earliest COVID-related onset and uninterrupted continuity are not established, so numeric duration remains withheld. Kazakh visitors were observed entering the Chinese section on 17 April 2023. The abandoned 8 January plan and the separate 24 April normal-operations announcement are not substituted for that scoped observed return. Ordinary road freight, rail traffic and commercial import permissions are outside this phase.
